sources.title: Bearing Life and Load Ratings
sources.scope: 查證具名案例與原理背景。課內數值、故障資料與判準為原創教學假設；請勿當作廠商規格或操作程序。
sources.scopeEn: Establish named case and principle context. Numbers, fault data, and criteria are original teaching assumptions, not manufacturer specifications or operating procedures.

related.title: 機械密封設計與檢驗
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：單位與指數正確，基本額定值沒有混入無依據修正因子或個體壽命保證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Units/exponent are correct and the rating has no unsupported factors or individual-life guarantee.
related.difference: 區分密封面線速度、摩擦功率及整台泵損耗，建立熱量去向圖。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish seal-face sliding speed, friction power and whole-pump loss, mapping heat destinations.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 球軸承基本額定壽命 L10=(C/P)^3 百萬轉，L10h=10^6L10/(60n)；它對應模型條件下90%可靠度的滾動疲勞額定值，其他失效機制未含。 教學 C=30 kN、等效動載荷P=10 kN、轉速n=1000 rpm；球軸承而非滾子。 L10=27百萬轉；L10h=27×10^6/(60×1000)=450 h。未計污染、潤滑及安裝因素。
平均半徑近似下 v=2πrn/60，摩擦功率Q=μFv；真實密封存在液膜與非均勻接觸。 純教學r=0.025 m、n=600 rpm、合成接觸力100 N、摩擦係數0.05。 v=1.5708 m/s；Q=0.05×100×1.5708=7.854 W。這不是任何密封操作規格。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For ball bearings L10=(C/P)^3 million revolutions and L10 h=10^6 L10/(60 n). This basic rolling-fatigue rating corresponds to 90% reliability under model assumptions; other failure modes are excluded. Teaching C 30 kN, equivalent dynamic load P 10 kN, speed 1000 rpm; ball bearings, not rollers. L10=27 million revolutions; L10 h=450 h, without contamination, lubrication or installation adjustments.

At mean radius v=2 π rn/60 and friction power Q=μ Fv; real seals include films and nonuniform contact. Teaching r 0.025 m, n 600 rpm, synthetic face force 100 N and friction coefficient 0.05. v=1.5708 m/s; Q=7.854 W, not a seal operating specification.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: 機器人力控裝配
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：單位與指數正確，基本額定值沒有混入無依據修正因子或個體壽命保證。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Units/exponent are correct and the rating has no unsupported factors or individual-life guarantee.
related.difference: 區分接觸剛性、力感測偏置與位置誤差，設計能辨識成因的離線試驗。
related.differenceEn: Distinguish contact stiffness, sensor bias and position error with an identifiable offline experiment.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 球軸承基本額定壽命 L10=(C/P)^3 百萬轉，L10h=10^6L10/(60n)；它對應模型條件下90%可靠度的滾動疲勞額定值，其他失效機制未含。 教學 C=30 kN、等效動載荷P=10 kN、轉速n=1000 rpm；球軸承而非滾子。 L10=27百萬轉；L10h=27×10^6/(60×1000)=450 h。未計污染、潤滑及安裝因素。
小變形一維接觸以F=kδ近似；感測值Fm=F+b，未接觸時也可有偏置b。 合成剛性k=2000 N/m、壓入δ=0.004 m、偏置b=1 N；不是實機裝配力設定。 真力8 N，讀值9 N；若忽略偏置由9/k反推位移，誤得4.5 mm而非4 mm。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: For ball bearings L10=(C/P)^3 million revolutions and L10 h=10^6 L10/(60 n). This basic rolling-fatigue rating corresponds to 90% reliability under model assumptions; other failure modes are excluded. Teaching C 30 kN, equivalent dynamic load P 10 kN, speed 1000 rpm; ball bearings, not rollers. L10=27 million revolutions; L10 h=450 h, without contamination, lubrication or installation adjustments.

Small one-dimensional contact uses F=k δ; measured force Fm=F+b can have nonzero bias before contact. Synthetic k=2000 N/m, compression 0.004 m, bias 1 N; not machine assembly-force settings. True force 8 N, reading 9 N; ignoring bias yields 9/k=4.5 mm instead of 4 mm.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

courses.overview: 比較相鄰案例與另一組案例的模型、可量測結果及可轉移的驗證方法。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighboring and cross-group cases by model, measurable outcome, and transferable verification method.
